name: terylon
description: Terylon, a Claude Code plugin marketplace: the roles of a small development team (product owner, developer pipeline, reviewer, tester) on Azure DevOps or GitHub, and Terylon, the agentic OS extension.

plugins.name: terylon-os
plugins.description: Terylon itself — the owner's MCP endpoint (/mcp) as a server, and one skill per prompt it serves: briefing, hand-over, merge-gate, add-goal, review-plan, show-story. Works in any session, the terminal, SSH and Remote Control alike. Requires the TERYLON_URL environment variable; there is no default address.

plugins.name: terylon-pane
plugins.description: The Terylon band, status line and pane in Claude Desktop, a mod: what waits for you above the prompt, the health of Agentic OS and today's spend in the status line, and one pane with Queue, Goals, Bell, Memory and Status tabs. It answers the leader's questions, adds tasks and goals, follows a run live and marks notices handled; it approves nothing. Requires terylon-os.

plugins.name: terylon-git
plugins.description: Git foundation — worktree isolation, the review engine, and the multi-lens code reviewer. No forge, no MCP server; works in any git repository. Requires terylon-core.

plugins.name: terylon-core
plugins.description: The marketplace's root — the conventions every persona shares and per-agent token-spend measurement read from a session's own transcripts. No git, forge, or MCP dependency. Successor to terylon-metrics.

plugins.name: terylon-forge
plugins.description: The forge port — pull request review, description, comment handling and checklist write-back, written against an operation catalog rather than one hosting platform. Ships no adapter: enable terylon-ado or terylon-github beside it. Successor to terylon-devops.

plugins.name: terylon-ado
plugins.description: The Azure DevOps adapter — fills the terylon-forge port with ADO mechanics over Microsoft's remote Azure DevOps MCP server (https://mcp.dev.azure.com), signed in with OAuth as the owner. The connect skill registers it from ADO_MCP_CLIENT_ID and ADO_MCP_TENANT_ID; every call carries ADO_ORGANIZATION. No default organisation.

plugins.name: terylon-github
plugins.description: The GitHub adapter — fills the terylon-forge port with gh CLI mechanics. No MCP server and no token in configuration: authentication is whatever gh auth login already established.

plugins.name: terylon-product
plugins.description: Product owner / PM — authoring User Stories grounded in the codebase and Feature specifications with a UX section. Requires terylon-forge and one adapter, terylon-ado or terylon-github.

plugins.name: terylon-dev
plugins.description: Developer pipeline — from a vague idea or a user story to implemented, tested code through brainstorm → plan → build (TDD) → finish, with an autonomous leader agent, parallel review lenses, the plan format and the build loop. Also dispatches long unattended background runs that commit after every step, so an interruption costs one step. Requires terylon-git, terylon-forge, one adapter, and terylon-core.

plugins.name: terylon-test
plugins.description: Tester — walks a pull request test plan and its linked item acceptance criteria, exercises what can be exercised, reconciles the two, and reports what cannot. Separates executed from asserted so a tick means something. Requires terylon-forge, one adapter, and terylon-core.
